Regional and local portals (not supported yet)

Source: Regional-portals.md

Sub-national portals (state, regional, municipal) that publish assessment documents the national portals miss. Notes only: nothing here is fetched by planscanR. Add an entry when you come across a portal; promote it to a source via ADDING_A_COUNTRY.md when there is a need. National portals still to add are in Countries-to-add.md.

Why this matters: some project types rarely reach the national EIA portal. German ground-mounted solar parks are mostly approved through a municipal zoning plan (Bebauungsplan) with an environmental report (Umweltbericht), so UVP-Verbund holds only 2-3 substantive solar dossiers (checked 2026-11-10). Its “Bauleitplanung” entries are only links to municipal websites.

Country Portal Covers What we know Checked
DE (Schleswig-Holstein) BOB-SH Bauleitplanung (B-Plan, F-Plan) participation for the whole state List of current and recent procedures (about 200, newest first, map view), dozens of Solarpark / Agri-PV B-Plans. A procedure page lists all PDFs, e.g. Solarpark Rader Insel: 12 PDFs incl. Begründung with Umweltbericht, Biotopkartierung, Artenschutzprüfung, Blendgutachten, Geräuschprognose. URLs: /verfahren/<uuid-or-slug>/public/detail, files /file/<slug>/<uuid>. Search facility unconfirmed. 2026-11-10
DE (Nordrhein-Westfalen) Beteiligung NRW Bauleitplan participation for participating municipalities 66 current and 736 ended Bauleitplan procedures, per municipality (/portal/<gemeinde>/beteiligung/themen/<id>). Share of solar procedures and document availability not checked. 2026-11-10
DE (federal) DiPlanung / DiPlanBeteiligung Federal participation platform used by several states Not checked. -
NL ruimtelijkeplannen.nl Zoning plans with appendices (b_<id>_tb.html) Holds specialist reports (ecology, noise) that commissiemer.nl lacks for about 20% of NL dossiers. Planned as an opt-in source (RPNL in the parent Plans.md). 2026-11-10
